name: Export this site
subtitle:
Everything travels by default — content, media, settings, themes, plugins, accounts, orders, invoices, comments and form leads. Leave the box below empty and you get the whole site.

Accounts, orders, invoices, comments and leads are records about people, so a bundle carrying them is a personal-data export the moment it leaves this server. Leave them out unless you are moving the shop itself.

Settle everything on this page first — the Export button is at the foot, below the credentials switch. A large site takes more than one press.

elements.label: Leave out
elements.hint: Anything you name here is not in the bundle. Everything else is, including anything added to this plugin in a future version — which is why this asks what to leave out rather than what to take.

elements.label: Include the image files
elements.hint: On, the bundle carries the actual files and the new site owns its pictures. Off, it carries only the records, the bundle is far smaller, and the new site loads images from this one until you upload them there.

name: Credentials
subtitle:
Off by default. Your payment gateway keys, mail password and AI key are never in a bundle unless you turn this on — and then only sealed under a passphrase you choose.

Send the passphrase to the other site separately from the file itself: together in one email, the encryption protects nobody.

confirm.title: Include your live credentials?
confirm.text:
Your payment gateway keys, mail password and AI key will be encrypted into this bundle.

Copying live gateway keys to a staging site means that site can charge real cards. Only do this if you are moving the shop itself.

The passphrase is never stored. Lose it and the credentials in the bundle cannot be recovered by anyone, including you.

elements.label: Include my payment, mail and AI credentials
elements.hint: Everything else on this page is content you authored. This is not.

elements.label: Passphrase
elements.hint: Never stored anywhere — not on this server, not in the bundle, not in the log.

elements.label: Passphrase again
elements.hint: Asked twice because a typo is not recoverable.

name: Export
subtitle: Everything above is decided before you press this. Each press works for about twenty seconds, writes down where it got to, and stops — so a run never dies half-way through with nothing to show for it. Press Export again to carry on.
